name: standmeet-smtp-mcp
description: The SMTP mail supplier as a standalone stdio-MCP block: it delivers mail over SMTP with nodemailer (a real library, unmodified) using credentials the substrate merges in per call, so it holds none and boots on a bare host. Mail is an app on a protocol, so it is a block — pluggable behind the mail seam's CallVerb — not an in-host protocol special-case; it carries no Go, and it OWNS its own error classification (auth/tls/connect/rejected), which the host surfaces verbatim. Wrapped the same way infra/plugins/caldav wraps its calendar tool.
